arcs.title: Operation Signal Zero
arcs.briefing: Free the rover, recover a school showcase’s missing broadcast, and leave a message for the next crew.

arcs.title: The Lost Blueprint
arcs.briefing: Collaborate to recover a lost research station through original expression, equation, and modeling puzzles.

missions.title: The Equation Vault
missions.summary: Explore variables on both sides, solution types, equation models, and error analysis.

missions.title: Signal Checkpoint
missions.summary: Practice solving linear equations to restore a station signal.

missions.title: The Blackout Ledger
missions.summary: Fund a receiver for a missing student broadcast: compare plans, model profit, and make whole-number decisions.

missions.title: The Signal Window
missions.summary: Plan a class Game Day. Use inequalities to stay within the snack-and-prize budget and leave time for cleanup.

missions.title: The Lost Blueprint
missions.summary: A cooperative escape-room challenge: simplify expressions, factor and distribute, analyze equations, and defend real-world decisions.

assignments.title: Unit 4 · Start here
assignments.instructions: Open the Equation Vault. Follow the guided examples, complete the mastery check, then submit your downloaded mission report in your class assignment.
assignments.nextStep: After submitting your Vault report, begin Mission 2: The Blackout Ledger when your teacher directs you.

assignments.title: Mission 2 · The Blackout Ledger
assignments.instructions: After completing Equation Vault, recover the missing broadcast. Work through all four chapters, record your reasoning, complete the mastery check, and download your mission report. Submit the report through your teacher’s class assignment.
assignments.nextStep: Submit your report, then wait for your teacher to release the next mission.

assignments.title: Unit 5 · The Signal Window
assignments.instructions: Begin this inequality mission after The Blackout Ledger or when your teacher assigns it. Complete four chapters with guided notes, number-line graphs, a practice challenge, and a five-question mastery check. Download your mission report and submit it through Canvas.
assignments.nextStep: Submit your report in Canvas. Review your explanations and any missed mastery questions with your teacher.

assignments.title: Units 3–4 · The Lost Blueprint (team extension)
assignments.instructions: After completing your assigned review and demonstrating readiness for the test, form a team of two or three. Rotate Solver, Challenger, and Explainer roles, complete every room with work on paper, and download your team report. Your teacher will review your explanations.
assignments.nextStep: Submit the team report as directed. If time remains, discuss the hardest puzzle with another team without revealing its answer.
